Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement residual is a positive multiple of ten, keeping leftovers on round boundaries that later items may fill exactly. This changes ranking only when round residuals occur, which may be uncommon, and it may chase roundness instead of tightness.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item > 0 and (r - item) % 10 == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
